11 Variants,,// Replace <sample_id> with your sample ID, e.g. sample_01
// Variant nodes + per-caller CALLED edge quality
column2: the Variant is reference-anchored

column1: // via AGAINST. One CSV row per (VCF row x SnpEff ANN entry). Requires '10
// VariantCallingRun' to have been loaded first (MATCH on process_run_id).
:auto LOAD CSV WITH HEADERS FROM 'file:///<sample_id>/kg/variants.csv' AS rec
var.TYPE      = CASE WHEN rec.TYPE      <> '' THEN rec.TYPE      ELSE null END,
var.EFFECT    = CASE WHEN rec.EFFECT    <> '' THEN rec.EFFECT    ELSE null END,
var.IMPACT    = CASE WHEN rec.IMPACT    <> '' THEN rec.IMPACT    ELSE null END,
var.gene_name = CASE WHEN rec.gene_name <> '' THEN rec.gene_name ELSE null END
SET c.DP     = CASE WHEN rec.DP   <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.DP) ELSE null END,

c.QUAL   = CASE WHEN rec.QUAL <> '' THEN toFloat(rec.QUAL) ELSE null END,
c.GQ     = CASE WHEN rec.GQ   <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.GQ) ELSE null END,
c.AO     = CASE WHEN rec.AO   <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.AO) ELSE null END,
c.RO     = CASE WHEN rec.RO   <> '' THEN toInteger(rec.RO) ELSE null END,
